assumptions.source: Bryant operating memory and SDLC master rules
assumptions.statement: Codex may choose repo, branch, worktree, tests, agents, and QA logistics without asking Bryant.
The normalized task brief is the source of accepted behavior unless repo docs provide stronger evidence.
Risk tier `critical` requires proof: red_green_test_log, fresh_verification_commands, code_review_artifact, release_gate, evidence_pack, minimal_hotfix_scope_proof.

questions.question: What user-visible or system behavior must change?

questions.answer: Unrelated refactors, unrelated product behavior, production/customer data mutation, and merge/deploy actions.
questions.question: What is outside the scope unless evidence proves it is required?

questions.answer: red_green_test_log, fresh_verification_commands, code_review_artifact, release_gate, evidence_pack, minimal_hotfix_scope_proof
questions.question: Which proof will be required before reporting done?

questions.answer: superpowers:brainstorming, superpowers:writing-plans, superpowers:test-driven-development, superpowers:verification-before-completion, superpowers:requesting-code-review, sdlc-run-ledger, sdlc-evidence-pack, superpowers:systematic-debugging
questions.question: Which skills must be used rather than reinvented?

reasons: No specialized domain keywords found; defaulting to general code workflow.
